items.title: t_fb3aa9d9: honor LIMIT bind markers in generic prepared SELECTs and open PR
items.notes: Ferrosa Memory PR #245 worked around the defect by interpolating a trusted integer literal. Current origin/main leaves LIMIT ? unresolved when cursor > ? disqualifies the exact-partition fast path, so the router treats the limit as absent and returns the full partition.
verification: frg run --tee -- cargo test -p ferrosa-cql prepared_select_bound_limit -- --nocapture
Real cached PREPARE/EXECUTE regression matches the mobile_control_events WHERE pk = ? AND cursor > ? LIMIT ? shape

items.goalSummary: Make prepared and literal SELECT LIMIT semantics identical without any unbounded fallback.
items.itemContribution: Prevents cursor replay queries from returning an entire partition when LIMIT is bound.
